description: Capabilities granted to writing help's popup, the small window that works over other applications. Narrower than the main window's: it listens for the shell's events and calls only the four shell commands its page names (ui/src/writing/WritingPopup.svelte) -- plus `call`, which src/guard.rs limits in this window to the two service commands the popup runs (the rewrite itself and settling it). No dialogs, no opener, no notifications; a paste that fails is reported by the shell, not by the popup.
